Why Creator Bench

Creator Bench (creatorbenchtool.com) is a free toolkit for YouTubers, Instagram and TikTok creators, built by an independent creator. It is not a talent-management or sponsorship platform. Each tool answers a question creators ask before every upload: how long is this script, will my title get cut off, is my text hidden behind the buttons, will my caption keep its spacing. No accounts, no watermarks, no uploads. Your work stays on your device.
